🚀 30 Days of VLSI Physical Design | Day 26/30: ICC2 / Fusion Compiler Commands – Work Smart, Debug Faster!

Command knowledge is an essential skill for a VLSI Physical Design Engineer. The right commands help us analyze the design, identify violations, optimize PPA, debug issues, and accelerate timing closure.

Flow: report_timing ➔ report_qor ➔ report_congestion ➔ Optimization ➔ Verify.
keyHighlight: 30 Days of VLSI · Day 26: ICC2 & Fusion Compiler Commands

content:
🚀 30 Days of VLSI Physical Design | Day 25/30: Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS) – Skew, Latency & NDR Rules!

Balancing global clock skew vs insertion delay in our 32nm RISC-V implementation. Used NDR 2W2S routing on clock trunks to eliminate cross-talk jitter and multi-VT buffer sizing for hold closure.

Key metric: Maintained global clock skew <80ps across all PVT corners.
keyHighlight: 30 Days of VLSI · Day 25: CTS & Clock Skew Optimization

content:
🚀 30 Days of VLSI Physical Design | Day 24/30: Static Timing Analysis (STA) – Fixing Hold Violations Post-Routing!

Debugging multi-corner multi-mode (MCMM) timing in PrimeTime across SS (0.95V, 125°C) and FF (1.25V, -40°C). Strategic high-VT delay buffer insertion on fast data paths cured hold without touching setup slack.

Result: 0ns hold violation with +0.22ns positive setup slack.
keyHighlight: 30 Days of VLSI · Day 24: STA & Hold Timing Closure

content:
🚀 30 Days of VLSI Physical Design | Day 23/30: Floorplanning & Power Mesh – Mitigating Dynamic IR Drop!

Macro placement sets 70% of tape-out quality. Placed memory macros on core periphery with 12µm placement halos, low-resistance top-metal straps (M7/M8), and verified dynamic IR drop under 2.8% of VDD.

Key rule: Never route high-speed signals across macro boundaries.
keyHighlight: 30 Days of VLSI · Day 23: Floorplan & Power Grid Synthesis

content:
🚀 30 Days of VLSI Physical Design | Day 22/30: Standard Cell Placement – Wirelength & Congestion Reduction!

Analyzing routing overflow using GCell heatmaps in Synopsys ICC2. Applied partial density screens (60%) around congested ALU multiplexers to disperse cell clusters and reduced total HPWL wirelength by 10%.

Flow: Global placement ➔ Congestion analysis ➔ Legalization ➔ Detailed placement.
keyHighlight: 30 Days of VLSI · Day 22: Placement & Congestion Control

content:
🚀 30 Days of VLSI Physical Design | Day 21/30: Physical Verification – DRC, LVS & Antenna Signoff!

Overcoming process antenna rule violations on long interconnect tracks. Applied metal layer hopping and inserted reverse-biased antenna diode cells to protect transistor gate oxide prior to GDSII stream-out.

Signoff status: 100% clean DRC & LVS verified.
keyHighlight: 30 Days of VLSI · Day 21: DRC/LVS & Antenna Verification
